# Lee Yunsung (이윤성)

> Lee Yunsung (b. 1985, Korea) is a painter who reworks the iconography of classical painting and sculpture — the Torso, Danae, Laocoon, Medusa, the Annunciation and the Zodiac — in the visual language of manga, anime and pixels, bringing Western classical images together with East Asian comics and animation. He works mainly in oil, and also makes sculpture editions, pen-plotter drawings and digital works. This is his official website.

Name: Lee Yunsung (family name first; Korean: 이윤성). Also written Yunsung Lee or Yun Sung Lee. Not to be confused with other people of the same name (photographers, writers, journalists).

## Facts
- Born 1985, Korea. Lives and works in Korea.
- Education: B.F.A. in Western Painting, Chung-Ang University, Seoul (2011)
- Award: DOOSAN Yonkang Arts Award in Visual Arts (2014); SDU ART PRIZE (2013)
- Residencies: DOOSAN Residency New York (2016); Makeshop Art Space STUDIO M17, Paju (2013)
- Collections: DOOSAN Art Center; SPACE K
- Publications: NU (Mediabus, 2016); The Drawing Book Torso 100 (Superellipse, 2020); Fragmentary (Superellipse, 2024)
- Main series: Torso, Danae, The Annunciation, Laocoon, Medusa, Zodiac and SD Zodiac, The Last Judgment, Prometheus and The Three Graces
